title: Account fees and minimum-balance charges - support procedure
content: Call Sense Bank's fictional schedule supplies the demo balance condition and any listed charge. Ask a demo agent to review the configured product before explaining a posted synthetic fee; no unlisted amount may be invented or waived by the assistant.
